$comment: Declarative config for nightly engine update checks. 'track' constrains updates to a version line (in-place updates only); major bumps are intentionally manual. Bump 'track' here to opt into a new major.

pnpm.$comment: Major pnpm bumps are not just a version edit: pnpm 11 renamed onlyBuiltDependencies -> allowBuilds (pnpm-workspace.yaml) and turns minimumReleaseAge (24h supply-chain delay) on by default, which can reject the lockfile refresh below. See docs/engine-updates.md.

emsdk.$comment: A newer emsdk ships a newer Clang that can fail third-party vcpkg ports built with -Werror (the 5.0.7 bump broke json-c on -Wunused-but-set-global). Such breaks surface only in the full compile and are fixed with an overlay port in build/vcpkg-ports/, not here.

vcpkg.$comment: Updating vcpkg also updates Qt (and all other vcpkg-managed C++ deps): the Qt version is whatever ports/qtbase ships at the new baseline. engines.qt is derived, not independently pinnable.

qgis.$comment: qgis-js tracks QGIS *master*, NOT a final-X_Y_Z release tag. The WASM build fixes (e.g. PR #64469 boardend/wasm-followup) are merged to master and are NOT backported to the release-X_Y branches, so a release tag would drop them. The port pins the master HEAD commit; needsUpdate compares that commit, not the (slow-moving) declared version. Re-pins on the same declared version must bump port-version instead of resetting it.
